prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one independent full-bleed event illustration for a nautical adventure game. Landscape 4:3 composition. Detailed hand-painted painterly realism, confident brushwork, believable weathered wood, bronze, rope, water and cloth. Strong clear main subject readable at 256px thumbnail, rich depth, natural anatomy. Tropical reef sea with bright turquoise blue-green water, dark rocky islets, warm wooden sailing craft, deep blue sky and sunlit clouds unless scene specifies night. Preindustrial age of sail. No text, lettering, logos, UI, title, border, collage, panels, watermark, or modern technology. Make one scene only. Primary request: Night on the warm wooden deck of a sailing ship. An exhausted sailor has fallen asleep sitting at the foot of the rope-and-wood mast ladder. Above him the small lookout platform is visibly empty. Two tired off-duty sailors stand nearby with restrained frustrated gestures. Single warm hanging lantern against cool deep-blue moonlit reef sea; quiet fatigue and crew tension, clear faces and coherent anatomy. No violence, no bottles suggesting drunkenness.
